in_sanskrit.name: द्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dyāḥ is a Sanskrit word that represents an offering, gift, or charity. It is derived from the root 'dā' which means 'to give'. In Hinduism, the act of giving is considered a sacred duty and a way to purify the mind and attain spiritual growth.

in_marathi.name: Dya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Deva’ meaning ‘God’. The name Dya is a feminine form and is used to signify a divine or goddess-like entity. In Hindu mythology, Dya is considered to be the goddess of fertility, prosperity, and wealth.
